refnamediv.refpurpose: Sets socket options for the socket

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
socket
A Socket instance created with socket_create or socket_accept.
level
The level parameter specifies the protocol level at which the option resides. For example, to set options at the socket level, a level parameter of SOL_SOCKET would be used. Other levels, such as TCP, can be used by specifying the protocol number of that level. Protocol numbers can be found by using the getprotobyname function.
option
The available socket options are the same as those for the socket_get_option function, plus the ones that only socket_set_option handles, listed with the form of value below.
value
The option value. Its form depends on the option:
forms of value
Option Value
SO_LINGER
An array (or an object) with the l_onoff and l_linger keys, each between 0 and 65535.
SO_RCVTIMEO, SO_SNDTIMEO
An array (or an object) with the sec and usec keys.
SO_BINDTODEVICE, TCP_CONGESTION A string: the name of the interface, or of the congestion control algorithm.
UDP_SEGMENT An int between 0 and 65535; 0 disables the segmentation.
SO_ATTACH_REUSEPORT_CBPF
An int: SKF_AD_CPU or SKF_AD_QUEUE attach the matching filter, 0 detaches it. Any other value emits an E_WARNING and &false; is returned.
IPV6_PKTINFO An array with the addr and ifindex keys.
MCAST_JOIN_GROUP, MCAST_LEAVE_GROUP, MCAST_BLOCK_SOURCE, MCAST_UNBLOCK_SOURCE, MCAST_JOIN_SOURCE_GROUP, MCAST_LEAVE_SOURCE_GROUP
An array (or an object) with the group and interface keys, and the source key for the options that name a source.
Any other option
An int. Other types are converted to an integer: "abc" or &null; become 0.
